annotations.text:
Frontier — MVP client, hi-fi.

Matched to the shipped watch client: same tokens, same 4px radii, same faction letters.

Things respond: feed tabs filter, hexes select, the stepper recomputes, route states switch.

UX §4.1 — three layers.

In sight: live.
Charted: dim, dated, terrain only.
Unknown: nothing drawn at all.

Drag the sensor range tweak and watch the board grow — that is the hull upgrade being felt rather than read.

UX §5.4 — a 409 is gameplay.

State the fact, then the remedy. Never blame, never the word "error", and the interface returns to exactly its prior state.
